title: Music Piece
location: Edmund Burke Theatre, Trinity College Dublin
notes:
Physical theatre piece about mystical experiences, time, and the dissolving of romantic relationships. Some audio is up on Bandcamp. 

Thomas Kerr - writer, director, composer
Laura Pendlebury - movement director
Jack Leitch - video design
Fiona Murray - management

Music credits:
Thomas Kerr - writing, guitar, bass, keys, drums, synths
Peter McMahon - fiddle on Knock, Turn
Fauré - notes on Jack Leitch (two movements of his Requiem)
Heaney - text of Twice Shy
